body.name: Simultaneous Monte Carlo risk programs
body.construction: Draw \(a_{\ell1},\ldots,a_{\ell N}\) independently from rule \(\ell\), form \(\widehat Q_{\ell}=N^{-1}\sum_sa_{\ell s}a_{\ell s}^{\mathsf T}\), and define \(V_{-}\) and \(V_{+}\) by the minimax SDP with \(Q_{\ell}\) replaced by \(\widehat Q_{\ell}-\varepsilon I_{2n}\) and \(\widehat Q_{\ell}+\varepsilon I_{2n}\), respectively; let \(q_{+}\) minimize the upper program.
